name: Ront
storyline:
Before the world existed, all of its matter and magic was held in one crystal, the Singularity. When it shattered, its fragments became the land, its creatures and two great shards: the Eastern and the Western Crown. Each Crown kept part of the Singularity's will and wants to reunite the world under its own rule, while a third will, the Matrix Heart, keeps either from ever ruling the whole.

Shardbound Adventurers are citizens attuned to the Singularity's shards. Each one swears to a Crown and fights in its war over roads, gates and capitals.
summary:
Ront is a free-to-play faction PvP MMO played in a web browser. Players become Shardbound Adventurers sworn to either the Eastern or the Western Crown, and both sides share one persistent pixel-art fantasy world. Characters level up, collect gear and combine skills freely, since there is no fixed class to choose.

The war between the two Crowns is fought across open fields, contested portals and towers, raid bosses and the rival capitals. Each side defends its own territory while preparing an invasion to break the enemy Crown Core. A broken Core ends the war, and its reform starts the next one.
